PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID.description: PayPal Developer Dashboard > Apps & Credentials > Sandbox app > Client ID

PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID.description: Developer Dashboard > your app > Webhooks > Webhook ID

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key. Optional: without it the offline rule-based AI fallback is used.

AGENT_API_TOKEN.description: Token the AI agent uses. Any long random string.

OWNER_API_TOKEN.description: Token only the human owner uses. Different from the agent token.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Forwarded Codespaces URL for port 3000, e.g. https://<name>-3000.app.github.dev
